description: Audit public websites for AI agent readiness and review evidence-backed Terms of Action.

interface.longDescription: WordLift AI Audit analyzes public website data to assess how well AI agents can discover, understand, and act on a site. It returns an evidence-backed audit with the site archetype, foundation findings, verified action-readiness, priority gaps, and Terms of Action. Use it to identify which actions agents can perform today, inspect the evidence behind each finding, and review the machine's interpretation with the site owner. Human feedback can produce a confirmed correction plan, but readiness changes only when supported by invocation evidence; the public remote plugin does not persist human refinements.
defaultPrompt: Audit wordlift.io and tell me what an AI agent can actually do there.
Run an AI Audit on my site, then help me review the Terms of Action it produced.
Why does the audit say my booking action is unverified?
